arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Calendar year 1980
redemptions_1980 = 71
outstanding_1979 = 352
outstanding_1980 = 300
avg_outstanding_1980 = (outstanding_1979 + outstanding_1980) / 2
rate_1980 = (redemptions_1980 / avg_outstanding_1980) * 100
print(f'1980 avg outstanding: {avg_outstanding_1980}')
print(f'1980 redemption rate: {rate_1980}%')

# Calendar year 1981
redemptions_1981 = 51
outstanding_1981 = 269
avg_outstanding_1981 = (outstanding_1980 + outstanding_1981) / 2
rate_1981 = (redemptions_1981 / avg_outstanding_1981) * 100
print(f'1981 avg outstanding: {avg_outstanding_1981}')
print(f'1981 redemption rate: {rate_1981}%')

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(rate_1980 - rate_1981)
print(f'Absolute difference: {diff:.2f}%')
"
